section.p: In the PocketBook Library, long-press an EPUB, FB2 or another supported book. Choose Open with, then CoolReader (it may be listed as cr3-pb.app).
If CoolReader is missing from Open with, follow README-touch-hd3.txt to add it to system/config/extensions.cfg.
The CoolReader entry in Apps reopens the last book you opened through the launcher. If that file is missing, this welcome document opens instead.
Your previous CoolReader books are also available from its Recent books menu.
This build targets PocketBook Touch HD 3 firmware 6.11.2001. On-device testing of this custom build is still required.
